subject: expr: support from_unixtime pushdown to tikv (#58941)
summary: Change only enables `ast.FromUnixTime` in the TiKV pushdown allowlist (`pkg/expression/infer_pushdown.go`), adds ExprToPB pushdown coverage (`pkg/expression/expr_to_pb_test.go`), and updates an explain golden file. Reviewed `fromUnixTimeFunctionClass`/`evalFromUnixTime` (timezone via `TypeCtx.Location()`, fsp derivation/rounding) and confirmed DAG requests carry `TimeZoneName`/`TimeZoneOffset`, so coprocessor evaluation has required session context; no Blocker/High correctness/semantics risks found. Later history up to `upstream/master` retains `FromUnixTime` pushdown (no revert/fix indicating a latent high-severity issue).
